text: Playgrounds need cushioned floors. Can a scrap tyre become one?

text: Crumb rubber already goes into playground floors and tiles.
Shred tyres, pull steel with magnets, blow off fibre, sieve the crumb.

text: Mix the crumb with a binder and press it into tiles.
